name: Wholesale Market Suite for WooCommerce
author: Teknisk Era

sections.description:
Wholesale Market Suite for WooCommerce helps you set wholesale prices and apply dynamic discounts based on product quantities and categories.

Detailed Description

Wholesale Market Suite for WooCommerce empowers store owners to offer wholesale pricing and flexible quantity-based discounts. You can configure product-wise and category-wise discount rules based on minimum and maximum quantities. Discounts can be applied to regular, sale, or wholesale prices individually, for both simple and variable products.

The plugin enhances your B2B sales capabilities by enabling dynamic pricing strategies and providing a seamless wholesale experience to your customers.

Features

  • Set wholesale prices for simple and variable products.
  • Show or hide retail prices for wholesale customers.
  • Apply product-based and category-based discounts according to quantity.
  • Discounts can target regular, sale, or wholesale prices.
  • Works seamlessly with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.
  • Category-based quantity discounts included in the free version.
  • Support for multiple product and category selection in a single rule.
  • Display regular, sale, and wholesale prices with applied discounts.
  • Discounts reflect on product pages, cart, and checkout automatically.

Learn more →

Premium Features

Upgrade to the Pro version for advanced wholesale features:

  • Product-based discount rules
  • Category-based discount rules
  • Cart-based discount rules
  • Tag-based discount rules
  • Attribute-based discount rules
  • Tiered wholesale pricing (based on quantity) for simple and variable products
  • Minimum and maximum order limits
  • Loyalty discounts for returning customers
  • Customer-level pricing (custom price levels)
  • Role-based pricing and discount rules
  • Automatic role assignment during registration
  • Custom approval workflow for wholesale user registration
  • Admin-friendly interface for managing discount rules in bulk

Pro Documentation
Live Demo
Buy Now on Codester

How It Works

  1. Edit a product and set its wholesale price in the product data section.
  2. Enable discount types (product or category) from the plugin settings.
  3. Add product or category rules with quantity ranges and discount values.
  4. Save the settings.
  5. Discounts are automatically applied to wholesale users who meet the rule conditions — visible on the shop, cart, and checkout.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for “Wholesale Market Suite for WooCommerce”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload it to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP.
  3. Unzip the plugin file.
  4. Go to your WordPress dashboard and activate it under Plugins.
sections.faq:
How do I set a wholesale price?

Edit any product. In the product data section, you’ll find a “Wholesale Price” field. Enter the amount and update the product.

Can I apply discounts to both products and categories?

Yes. You can set up quantity-based discounts for individual products or for entire categories.

Are variable products supported?

Yes, both simple and variable products support wholesale pricing and dynamic discounts.
